title: Compliance export builder and SLA-aware evidence bundles
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a self-service Export Builder in the Console that produces tamper-evident, SLA-aware evidence bundles (PDF and CSV) for tenants. Bundles must: honor per-tenant data residency rules, apply retention truncation/redaction, be encrypted with tenant KMS keys when required, include signed checksums and a human-readable manifest, and support scheduled delivery to region-appropriate object stores or secure download links. Provide both ad-hoc and recurring exports, webhook callbacks for delivery confirmation, retry/backoff policies, and audit trail entries. The feature should be usable by platform and compliance teams and expose SDK/API endpoints for automation.
acceptance_criteria: Console: Export Builder UI allows selecting tenant scope, date window, format (PDF/CSV), residency enforcement, and delivery target (S3/GCS/manual).
Exports respect tenant-specific residency: data stored in EU tenants is packaged and routed to EU object storage endpoints only.
Retention windows are enforced during packaging: records older than tenant retention policy are excluded or redacted per policy.
Bundles contain: a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums for each file), an export_summary.pdf with human-readable evidence, and CSVs with machine-readable rows.
Exports are encrypted at rest using tenant KMS keys when tenant has KMS enabled; encryption metadata recorded in audit log.
Scheduled jobs run on configurable CRON-like schedules and surface next-run/last-run status in Console with success/failure details.
Delivery channels support region-aware routing (e.g., eu-west S3 endpoints for EU tenants) and webhooks that confirm delivery and checksum match.
Backfill API supports producing historical bundles and is rate-limited; backfills record cost estimates before run.
Telemetry emitted for export_start, export_complete, export_failure with tenant, bundle_size, duration, and bytes_by_region.
Docs and customer-facing UI copy explain residency guarantees, expected SLA (e.g., scheduled exports delivered within 15 minutes of completion), and retry behavior.
End-to-end QA: generate exports for at least three residency permutations (US-only tenant, EU-only tenant, multi-residency enterprise) and validate checksums and KMS behavior.
